display_title: How to Deal With Moaning Between Floors
description:
“I’m so fed up that I’ll just find myself any strong, well-built man and do it with him every day.” The moment she said that, a faint crease appeared between Kang Seunghyeon’s brows as he read the note. “You said there are plenty of crazy bastards in the world, and that you don’t date because you don’t have time to pick out one who’s trustworthy and your type.” “And now you’re saying you’ll just find any strong, well-built man and do it with him every day?” “Then do it with me. I’m big.”
